How To Edit The SEO For Social Media Sharing for SEO Templates
## Overview
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/5000682655

## Steps
• Navigate toMy Content>SEO Templates.
• Locate the relevant template and clickCustomizeorEdit.
• On theSEO Settingstab, scroll down to theSocial Media Sharingsection.
• Update the fields as needed.
• ClickSave This Page.

## Social Media Shared Image
A Social Media Shared Image can be set for the template. As with other SEO settings, this is treated as a suggestion, social media platforms and search engines determine at their own discretion whether to use the supplied image.
A generic, default social media image can also be configured; this is covered separately in the " How to Set a Default Social Media Image " article.
